title: The phone profile job names a save timeout instead of telling you to unlock the phone
why: A wrong hint sends you to fix the phone when the tool hung.
note: Finding, Oct 26 (local liaison, c48 part 2 on the Mac): when xctrace hangs while saving after a full recording (exit 124 at the step timeout, seen once with HomeApp), bin/ios-ship profile reports "failed twice" and says the phone may need unlocking, which is wrong there. Fix, one small cloud lane, needs no answer from you: print the unlock hint only when the second failure also shows the boot-wait text; otherwise name the timeout. Red first with a stubbed exit-124 run in shell-macos. Port: yes, ios-ship serves every app repo. Placed after c69 (triage, Oct 26): small, and it misleads only on a rare hang.
